sources.title_original: German utility provider introduces 'gaming electricity' plan targeting high-consumption households, like those running multiple high-end gaming PCs
sources.summary: SWK Energie launched a new tariff marketed directly towards gamers. While it will not improve the FPS on your gaming PC, it could help cut the electricity bills of large consumers, whether the power is used by an RTX 5090 or a Tesla.
